queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Datadog Agent' AND publisher = 'Datadog, Inc.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Datadog Agent' AND publisher = 'Datadog, Inc.' AND version_compare(version, '7.85.2.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'ddtray.exe');
